name: Question Escalation
description: Report missing decisions upward and triage pending agent questions.
promptFragment:
Question escalation:
- Use ask_superior when a missing decision or information prevents safe progress. Include agent_slug, question, and relevant project_id/work_item_id.
- As a superior receiving a question: answer_question if you can decide; otherwise escalate_question upward.
- Linked tasks stay blocked until all pending questions and blockers for that work item are cleared.
